title: Craft Blend 3-Mix Trio #07 (L:대각 띠·물결 / C:가로 띠·물결 / R:부채꼴·매끈)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Ethiopian woman in her late 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, smooth warm-brown skin, a bold thick black liner drawn around the whole eye and winged slightly at the outer corner, warm gold and brown eyeshadow, strongly defined softly arched brows, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a natural warm rose-brown lip with a soft gloss, a serene, dignified expression, cool and composed, deep dark brown hair styled in braided, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glittery finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 46% of the way down her figure from the top and about 73% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Japanese maki-e gold-powder lacquer (a deep glossy black urushi lacquer ground scattered with a traditional motif — cherry blossoms, cranes among pine, or maple leaves — rendered in fine sprinkled gold powder), wide gold-powder bands following the contours of the body, dense gold powder glittering densely filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), wide bold silver bands following the contours of the body, dense lattice fills filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Filipino Yakan painted pattern (a black ground densely patterned with bright geometric diamond bands), wide magenta-and-gold bands following the contours of the body, dense geometric diamond work filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto slingbacks, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult French woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair natural skin with a light dewy finish, softly brushed natural brows, a barely-there brown liner and fluttering lashes, no eyeshadow, soft natural colour on the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a single bold classic red lip with a soft matte finish, an unbothered, effortless expression, demure and soft, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back, real living eyes. Long square nails, glittery finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 42% of the way down her figure from the top and about 73% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Finnish Iittala glass-inspired linework (a deep indigo ground with bold cream concentric ripple-line motifs), wide cream bands following the contours of the body, dense concentric ripple linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Indian Mughal miniature gold-work (a deep midnight-blue ground with fine gold linework and medallions), wide gold-and-crimson bands following the contours of the body, dense jewel-toned scrollwork filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult German woman in her late 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, demure and soft, deep dark brown hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real living eyes. Long almond nails, glittery finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 60% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 7 o'clock, 10 o'clock and 3 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 7 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense folk-art floral motifs filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, dense floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 7 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: both arms raised overhead, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform stiletto slingbacks, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
